ArticleLink.title: ArticleLink
ArticleLink.description: An external reference link attached to a news article.

NewsArticle.title: NewsArticle
NewsArticle.description: A published news article on the UR SKY News network.

category.description: Preset or custom editorial category of the news article.

authorName.description: Display name of the journalist or editor.

content.description: Full editorial body text of the news article.

imageUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS URL or compressed base64 data URI for the article cover image.

links.description: Up to 10 external links with titles attached to the article.

holidayType.description: Classification when the article is an official holiday announcement.

holidayOccasion.description: Specific occasion name (e.g., عيد الفطر) when holidayType is a religious/other occasion or passing.

holidayGovernorates.description: Selected Iraqi governorates included in the official holiday, or ['جميع أنحاء العراق'] for all governorates.

isPublished.description: Whether the article is publicly visible on the news portal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the article was published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the article was last updated.

AdminToken.title: AdminToken
AdminToken.description: Write-only atomic verification token proving admin passcode knowledge during news mutations.

code.description: Admin secret passcode validated server-side by Firestore rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the token was issued.

/news/{articleId}.description: Publicly readable published news articles protected by atomic admin passcode tokens.

/admin_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Write-only atomic passcode verification records paired with news mutations.
